mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `USER` (USER_NAME, USER_EMAIL, USER_PASSWORD_HASH, USER_NICKNAME, USER_PHONE_NUMBER) VALUES (#{userVO.userName}, #{userVO.userEmail}, #{userVO.userPasswordHash}, #{userVO.userNickname}, #{userVO.userPhoneNumber})
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `USER` WHERE USER_PHONE_NUMBER = #{phoneNumber} AND USER_STATUS != 'WITHDRAWN')
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `USER` WHERE USER_EMAIL = #{email} AND USER_STATUS != 'WITHDRAWN')
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `USER` WHERE USER_NICKNAME = #{userNickname} AND USER_STATUS != 'WITHDRAWN')
SELECT USER_PASSWORD_HASH FROM `USER` WHERE USER_EMAIL = #{email} AND USER_STATUS != 'WITHDRAWN'
SELECT USER_ID FROM `USER` WHERE USER_EMAIL = #{email} AND USER_STATUS != 'WITHDRAWN'
SELECT USER_EMAIL FROM `USER` WHERE USER_PHONE_NUMBER = #{phoneNumber} AND USER_STATUS != 'WITHDRAWN'

SELECT USER_ID AS userId, USER_NAME AS userName, USER_EMAIL AS userEmail, USER_NICKNAME AS userNickname, USER_PHONE_NUMBER AS userPhoneNumber FROM `USER` WHERE USER_PHONE_NUMBER = #{phoneNumber} AND USER_STATUS != 'WITHDRAWN'
